summary: Frontend tests (Playwright, America/Chicago browser context; current local time 2026-11-25 ~22:00 CST) of the new DateTimeField (popover Calendar single mode + 15-min time Select + quick picks) in FollowUpDialog (schedule, reschedule, log next-when) and the Book inspection dialog. Saved values were checked through the API. All requested checks PASS. Schedule Nov 30 2:45 PM saved due_at 2026-11-30T20:45Z, the expected value. Default is tomorrow 9:00 AM. There are 96 time options. The popover closes after a day is picked and the dialog stays open. All 4 quick picks update the day label and the time. Reschedule of an off-grid time (API-created 10:07): prefills Fri Nov 27 | 10:07 AM; the extra 10:07 option is present and checked (97 options); an unchanged save keeps 2026-11-27T16:07Z; moving to Nov 29 saves 2026-11-29T16:07Z. Midnight boundary: 23:45 today shows the 'Today' badge and 00:00 tomorrow shows 'Upcoming'. Home Follow-ups due (/dashboard/attention?tz=America/Chicago and the Home card) includes the 23:45 one and not the 00:00 one. DST: 2026-11-01 11:30 PM -> 2026-11-02T05:30Z; 2026-03-08 11:30 PM -> 2026-03-09T04:30Z (calendar navigated back 8 months). Reopening reschedule shows the same day and 11:30 PM for both. DST gap 2026-03-08 02:30: the UI label changes straight to 3:30 AM before saving, saves 2026-03-08T08:30Z, and reopens as Mar 8 | 3:30 AM. Book inspection: Dec 10 1:30 PM -> inspection_date 2026-12-10T19:30:00Z, with the inspector and notes saved. After the popover was used, typing still worked in the dialog inputs, so there is no focus-trap issue. The Job page DateRangePicker (job-dates-trigger) opens a 2-month popover and closes on Escape; nothing was saved. No console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the day that is already selected does nothing: react-day-picker single mode sends undefined (deselect), the onSelect guard ignores it, and the popover stays open. The value is kept and Save stays enabled, which is harmless. Possible fix: close the popover in that case too (onSelect={(d)=>{ if (d) set(d,hm); setOpen(false); }}) or use the `required` prop.

'Later today' = now rounded down to the hour + 2h. After about 22:00 local time it gives a time after midnight, so it lands tomorrow (at 21:57 it gave 11 PM; from 22:00 it gives 12 AM the next day). This is pre-existing quickPicks logic.

action_items: Optional (LOW): close the DateTimeField popover when the already-selected day is clicked again
Optional (LOW): limit or hide 'Later today' when now+2h is after midnight
critical_code_review_comments: DateTimeField keeps the 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm' contract through toLocalInput(new Date(y,m,d,h,min)), so storage, time-zone and DST handling are unchanged; verified with saved values.

The Save-disabled-when-empty path (needsWhen && !when) cannot be reached from the UI because the field always has a value (default plus no clear control). The 'Pick a day' placeholder only shows if a parent passes an empty value.
